args: & {Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; if (Test-Path '.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1') { .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; python bot.py } else { Write-Host 'Virtual environment not found!' -ForegroundColor Red }}

tasks.label: Install Dependencies
args: & {Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; if (Test-Path '.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1') { .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt } else { Write-Host 'Virtual environment not found!' -ForegroundColor Red }}

tasks.label: Activate Virtual Environment
args: & {Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; if (Test-Path '.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1') { .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; Write-Host 'Virtual environment activated!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Virtual environment not found!' -ForegroundColor Red }}
